description.value:
Crackling energy wraps around you and your gear, granting you 5 temporary hit points for the duration. While you have these hit points, any creature that hits you with a melee attack takes 5 lightning damage.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 2nd level or higher, both the temporary hit points and the lightning damage increase by 5 for each slot level beyond 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
